{{DISPLAYTITLE:100% Completion in ''GTA San Andreas''}}{{Quote|100% achieved! Stats and cash have been boosted! Rhino and Hydra delivered to CJ's house in Grove Street.|Message received upon 100% completion.}}Attaining [[100% Completion]] in {{SA}} requires the completion of numerous tasks, listed below.

However, ''GTA San Andreas'' has extra tasks that are not required for the achievement, but are also available to complete.

==Required Tasks==

* Complete the main story [[Missions in GTA San Andreas|missions]] ([[In the Beginning]] to [[End of the Line]])
* Completing all vehicle missions
* Completing all Asset missions
* Completing all Race missions
* Completing all Schools to bronze
* Purchase all Properties
* Complete all 4 Collectables
* Complete Gun and Gym Challenges
* Complete Vehicle Export List
* Complete all 6 heist missions{{Ref|ref=Not required for storyline progress.}}:
** [[File:Radar-CashIcon-GTASA.png|20x20px]] [[Architectural Espionage]]
** [[File:Radar-CashIcon-GTASA.png|20x20px]] [[Key to Her Heart]]
** [[File:Radar-CashIcon-GTASA.png|20x20px]] [[Dam and Blast]]
** [[File:Radar-CashIcon-GTASA.png|20x20px]] [[Cop Wheels]]
** [[File:Radar-CashIcon-GTASA.png|20x20px]] [[Up, Up and Away!]]
** [[File:Radar-CashIcon-GTASA.png|20x20px]] [[Breaking the Bank at Caligula's]]

==Rewards==
[[File:100%-GTASA.png|thumb|The message received upon 100% completion.]]
When 100% is achieved in the game, the following rewards are given:
*[[Money|$]]1,000,000
*Infinite ammunition for all weapons{{Ref|ref=Carl Johnson will still be required to reload his weapons, unlike in the Infinite Ammo [[Cheats in GTA San Andreas|cheat]].}}
*Double vehicle strength for any vehicle [[Carl Johnson]] drives
*[[Hydra]] on the roof of [[Sweet's House|Sweet's house]]
*[[Rhino]] under the [[Ganton Bridge]], near [[Ryder's House|Ryder's house]]
*[[Remastered]] [[Achievements and Trophies in GTA San Andreas|achievement/trophy]] {{Small|({{TDE}})}}

==Non-Required Tasks==
===Missions===
*[[Burglar]]: Earn at least $10,000 (unlocks infinite sprint)
*[[Big Smoke's Cash]]{{Ref|name=yay|ref=Only available from [[Gone Courting]] until [[Yay Ka-Boom-Boom]].}}
*[[Yay Courier]]{{Ref|name=yay}}
*[[Kickstart]]: Get the perfect score of 61 points (68 on the [[PlayStation 3|PS3]] and ''The Definitive Edition'' versions)
*[[File:Radar-SchoolIcon-GTASA.png|20px]] [[Schools in GTA San Andreas|Schools]]: Get a gold medal in all 33 tests

===Sports===
*[[Beat the Cock!]]: Win in first place in both triathlons
*Win a game of [[Pool#Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas|Pool]]
*Play [[basketball]]
*Use all types of gym equipment at least once:
**Treadmill
**Stationary bike
**Bench press
**Dumbbells

===Minigames===
*[[Rhythm-based Minigames#Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas|Dancing]]: Complete all 3 levels
*Win the [[Lowrider Challenge]] once
*Play [[Beefy Baron]]
*Beat the high scores in all four [[Arcade Games#Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas|arcade games]]:
**[[Go Go Space Monkey]]
**[[Let's Get Ready to Bumble]]
**[[Duality]]
**[[They Crawled from Uranus]]
*Win all [[gambling]] games once each:
**[[Inside Track]]
**Blackjack
**Roulette
**Slot Machines
**Video Poker
**Wheel of Fortune

===Collectibles===
*Complete all 70 [[Stunt Jumps in GTA San Andreas|Unique Stunt Jumps]]

===Purchases===
*[[File:Radar-ClothesIcon-GTASA.png|20px]] Buy all purchasable clothes from these stores:
**[[Binco (3D Universe)|Binco]]
**[[Sub Urban (3D Universe)|Sub Urban]]
**[[ProLaps (3D Universe)|ProLaps]]
**[[ZIP (3D Universe)|ZIP]]
**[[Victim]]
**[[Didier Sachs (3D Universe)|Didier Sachs]]

===Stats===
*Control 100% of the 53 available territories in [[Gang Warfare in GTA San Andreas|gang wars]]{{Ref|ref=The player only needs to control 35% of the territories to finish the game storyline.}}
*[[File:Radar-GirlfriendIcon-GTASA.png|20px]] Get 100% relationship progress with all six [[Girlfriends in GTA San Andreas|girlfriends]]
*Max out all [[Statistics|stats]]:
**Fat
**Stamina
**[[Respect]]
**Lung Capacity
**Sex Appeal
**Muscle
**Driving Skill
**Flying Skill
**Bike Skill
**Cycling Skill
*Get the gambling skill to Whale
*Get the [[Statistics#Weapon Skill|weapon skill]] to Hitman (1000 points) for these weapons:
**[[Pistol (3D Universe)|Pistol]]
**[[Silenced 9mm|Silenced Pistol]]
**[[Desert Eagle]]
**[[Shotgun (3D Universe)|Pump Shotgun]]
**[[Sawed-Off Shotgun|Sawn-Off Shotgun]]
**[[Combat Shotgun]]
**Machine Pistol ([[Tec-9]] and [[Micro SMG (3D Universe)|Micro SMG]])
**[[SMG (3D Universe)|SMG]]
**[[AK47|AK-47]]
**[[M16|M4]]
